verdict.rationale: Docusign advertises 'configurable workflows,' conditional logic in web forms, and CLM's drag-and-drop workflow builder, plus MCP-based 'trigger workflow actions through IAM tools,' suggesting some rule-based automation exists. However there's no concrete documentation of an event-trigger/webhook rule engine (e.g., Docusign Connect-style event listeners) or examples of automatically firing actions on defined events. Missing for 10: explicit event/trigger API or webhook docs, examples of rule definitions, independent verification that automation runs reliably without manual intervention.
